# Wallet Standard app

`wallets.js` and its source map are copied unchanged from `@wallet-standard/app` 1.1.1, published on npm. This small browser registry discovers installed wallets; it contains no Blockword account or signing logic. The Apache-2.0 license is included in `LICENSE`.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wallet-standard/app/v/1.1.1

Registry tarball integrity:

```text
sha512-WDGwoByhP5gwHH01r5EaLgQdLVkACPCdOMQhmhn8rsm10h/siSgTorShzBxrn0ExSPof+Lu+C3TfgqBrPa1xoQ==
```

The downloaded tarball was checked against that SHA-512 digest before copying these files. Blockword uses Aptos Wallet Standard feature methods in `static/accounts.mjs`. No npm installation or browser-side CDN request is needed to run this version.
